_: Written by tools/gen_gateway_ported.py; do not edit by hand. Each ported Python file's SHA-256 is the one it had when the Go gateway was last brought level with it. tests/test_gateway_go.py fails when one differs: port the change to Go (or read it and confirm it does not touch what the Go gateway carries), then re-run the tool.

src/autopilot/engine/auth.py.carries: WorkloadAuthenticator (TokenReview, the audience set), CachingAuthenticator; S1: OIDCAuthenticator (Dex), ForeignWorkloadAuthenticator (Tower), GitHubActionsAuthenticator (ported and tested, not wired: serve.py does not wire it), RoutingAuthenticator, JWKS

src/autopilot/engine/backends.py.carries: BackendError (evidence, agent message), Handler, RunBackend (and a fake), the human inbox's handlers (human.request, human.request.get)
src/autopilot/engine/backends.py.left_for_later_slices: S5 the other core tools' handlers (repo.*, artifacts, chat)

src/autopilot/engine/control.py.carries: ControlError, check_reason, check_hours, Hold and its store, may_manage: the person controls

src/autopilot/engine/core.py.carries: the decision path: evaluation, outcome, records, outbox, outage policy, canonical JSON, the client's timeout (DECISION_TIMEOUT), retries and breaker

src/autopilot/engine/definitions.py.carries: reading the bundled set and the pinned set
src/autopilot/engine/definitions.py.left_for_later_slices: S4 publishing the set, bundled_set, the Agent XR loader

src/autopilot/engine/dispatch.py.carries: Gateway.call (decision, charge, handler, outcome, backend-failure text and evidence), open_session, the outage path, tools_list, agents_for; the run tree: launch, _spawn (the child is the core's grant, checked), run.close, finish_run, close_session, expire and _backstop_outcomes, _delete_runs, _acting (a run acts as its session), _record and the flight recorder's fields, _def, _candidate's clamp and run_agent from the person's own session on; S3: _person, _manager, freeze_session, end_session, hold_triggers, release_triggers, hold_for, human_requests, human_answer and the inbox's handlers, open_triggered, record_event, run_agent (the route's checks, holds, Preflight candidates as far as Candidate goes), preflight_case_list and preflight_score
src/autopilot/engine/dispatch.py.left_for_later_slices: S4 publish_definitions, apply_cluster_definitions and the schema validation a candidate document needs (a `document` is refused until then)

src/autopilot/engine/events.py.carries: the event history: from_summary and the record

src/autopilot/engine/inbox.py.carries: the human inbox: the request, its checks, who may answer, the store

src/autopilot/engine/limits.py.carries: budget fields, limits, LimitRequest and narrow (a request can only narrow)

src/autopilot/engine/modelproxy.py.carries: the model proxy: decision, metering, charge

src/autopilot/engine/pg.py.carries: the tables, the writer lock, sessions, run results, the outbox, the inbox, holds, the event history and the trigger ledger and cursors (schema.sql is generated)

src/autopilot/engine/profile.py.carries: parse: scope, agent, runs_in, the interval and Glidepath event triggers

src/autopilot/engine/results.py.carries: observe, warnings, clip_text, tool_call_summary, the result store (memory, and gateway_results) and its retention

src/autopilot/engine/server.py.carries: the MCP server surface: tools_list, agents_list, session_open, call, run_finish, session_close, healthz, protected-resource metadata, the people routes (/v1/...: the inbox, freeze, end, hold, release, run, Preflight)

src/autopilot/engine/session.py.carries: the session record (every field, signals included), budgets, breaker, expiry, the run tree (MAX_DEPTH, close, the cut of a child, the reservation a spawn makes on its parent)

src/autopilot/engine/tiers.py.carries: ToolSpec, tiers, the target and effect of a call

src/autopilot/engine/trigger_ledger.py.carries: the trigger ledger and the cursors: claim, decide, advance, prune, the keys

src/autopilot/event_bridge.py.carries: the event bridge: the stream, the catch-up, the cursor, the brake, the summary, the history (on a client of its own, with limits)

src/autopilot/gateway.py.carries: which tool has a handler in a deployment (metrics.query, logs.query, run.spawn, run.close), AgentRunBackend (the run's name, its identity, how it ended)

src/autopilot/hangar_tools.py.carries: the Hangar tool pack (registry.json is generated)

src/autopilot/kube_runs.py.carries: the AgentRun store over the Kubernetes API: the three requests, the allowlist, KubeRunError, RunRefused

src/autopilot/manifests.py.carries: the AgentRun manifest and the run name

src/autopilot/preflight.py.carries: the cases, the checks, the score, the ledger and the fingerprint (Go's own digest) behind the Preflight routes; the scripted-run harness is Python's local tooling

src/autopilot/scheduler.py.carries: interval triggers: slots, grace, missed slots, once per slot

src/autopilot/serve.py.carries: the settings this slice carries (S1: AUTOPILOT_OIDC_*, TOWER_*, the authenticator chain), start-up, the expiry sweep (closing, deleting runs, the backstop outcomes), the outbox drain, the run backend and result store; S3: EVENTS_ENABLED and GLIDEPATH_API_URL (with it), SCHEDULES_ENABLED, RECONCILE_SECONDS, RECONCILE_WINDOW_HOURS, AUTOPILOT_DELEGATES, AUTOPILOT_ADMINS, RUNTIME_IMAGES_EXTRA, PREFLIGHT_CASES_DIR, the bridge, the sweep and the scheduler
src/autopilot/serve.py.left_for_later_slices: S4/S5/S6 the settings and loops of what is not ported (the Backstage directory, the metrics port)

src/autopilot/triggers.py.carries: the topic matcher (as a table, not a recursion), the Glidepath event matcher, interval parsing, the task ids, the storm brake; alert and RabbitMQ matchers have no caller in Python and are not carried

src/autopilot/vendor/agentrun_compose.py.carries: what the gateway reads of the composition: RUN_NAME, the run namespace's name (agent-<run>) and its service account `run` (the run's identity), the input's size limit. The rendering itself runs in the cluster, not in the gateway

out_of_scope.src/autopilot/backends.py: the test fakes (FakeGlidepath, Recorder): the Go gateway registers no fake
out_of_scope.src/autopilot/cli.py: the Python command line (preflight, reads): not part of the gateway process
